block.guhs.guh_dakpan_grijs_plaat: Soft Gray Guh Roof Tile Slab
block.guhs.guh_dakpan_grijs_trap: Soft Gray Guh Roof Tile Stairs
block.guhs.shoji.lore: Click: the panel slides open. Two side by side slide open together. Nyeg!
block.guhs.tatami.lore: Two side by side become one mat. Sneaking: half a mat. Lovely for a chonky lie-down.
block.guhs.toro.lore: Lights up by itself when it gets dark, and goes out again in the morning.
block.guhs.geharkt_zand.lore: Rake it with a hoe for a different pattern. You can rake plain sand too.
block.guhs.geharkt_zand_ring.lore: Makes rings around a boulder or a circle by itself. Sneak with a hoe: turn it yourself.
block.guhs.bonsai_pot.lore: Snip it with shears for a different shape. Snip snip, nyeg.
block.guhs.guh_dakpan_roze_hoek.lore: Curls up by itself at the end and on the corner of your roof edge. Wahoog!
block.guhs.guh_dakpan_wit_hoek.lore: Curls up by itself at the end and on the corner of your roof edge. Wahoog!
block.guhs.guh_dakpan_grijs_hoek.lore: Curls up by itself at the end and on the corner of your roof edge. Wahoog!
